events.name: Davisito Navarro’s Birthday Party & Album Release with Special Guest Yissy Garcia
events.info: Davisito Navarro's Birthday Party & Album ReleaseCelebrate Cuban jazz, New Orleans groove, and the release of Davisito Navarro's debut album with a special birthday concert at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro. The CubaNOLA Arts Collective alongside NOLAxNOLA present two stellar performances and an afterparty. A rising star of the next generation of Cuban jazz musicians, Davisito Navarro has performed with leading artists in Cuban music and salsa, including Emilio Morales, Bellita y su Jazztumbatá, El Niño y la Verdad, and José Alberto , "rdquo" -> El Canario." Since moving to New Orleans in 2023, he has become a familiar presence on the city's music scene, performing with the New Orleans Jazz Orchestra, Charlie and the Tropicales, Mariachi Jalisco, Alexey Marti & AfroGumbo, and Delfeayo Marsalis and the Uptown Jazz Orchestra. Yissy Garcia is one of Cuba's most exciting and innovative percussionists. Blending Afro-Cuban rhythms with jazz, funk, R&B, and electronica, she has shared the stage with artists including Dave Matthews, Esperanza Spalding, Allison Russell, Concha Buika, and Joshua Bell. Her performances have been featured at NPR's Tiny Desk, Lincoln Center, the Kennedy Center, SXSW, and other major stages around the country. The evening also celebrates the release of Davisito + El Negro: Live from New Orleans, recorded live, right here at Snug Harbor on September 27, 2026. The album features 10 songs---including five original compositions and fresh interpretations of Cuban and New Orleans classics. After Party begins 11:30 PM with DJ Santero - We'll be celebrating Davisito's birthday after the show with an Afro-Cuban After Party with world renowned DJ Santero. For an extra $10 on the ticket price, keep the celebration going with renowned DJ Santero spinning a high-energy dance mix of Timba, Rumba, Afro-Cubanía, Reparto, and Gozadera---with the best Cuban dance hits from back in the day to present. It will be a who's who of local and visiting Cuban musicians with lots of surprise guests. There's a special discount on the After Party tickets for those who attend the performance. Get both, your performance and after party tickets now! Tonight's engagement is presented in partnership with CubaNOLA Arts Collective and NOLAxNOLA and features: David Navarro - trumpet, timbales, vocal Yissy Garcia - drums, percussion Oscar Rossignoli - piano Alexey Marti - percussion Brent Rose - saxophone Lino Piquero - bass Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Afterparty begins at 11:30pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Afterparty begins at 11:30pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner

events.name: Nickel-A-Dance presents: A Tribute to Ronell Johnson
events.info: Nickel-A-Dance presents: A Tribute to Ronell JohnsonNickel-A-Dance is a free, family-friendly jazz concert series in New Orleans, celebrating the city's rich musical heritage. Founded in 1994, it features top local jazz musicians performing classic jazz, blues, and swing. Originally held at Café Brasil on Frenchmen Street, the series now takes place at Snug Harbor Jazz Bistro on Sundays from 3:00--6:00 PM. The event is open to all ages and aims to make live jazz accessible to everyone. Ronell Johnson, affectionately known as , "rdquo" -> Roobone," was a celebrated New Orleans multi-instrumentalist and vocalist whose principal instrument was trombone. A gifted musician from an early age, Ronell began performing professionally at 12 and went on to master trombone, tuba, piano, and organ. A longtime member of the Preservation Hall Jazz Band, Ronell carried the tradition of New Orleans jazz to stages around the world, performing and collaborating with artists including Tom Waits, Steve Earle, Bonnie Raitt, My Morning Jacket, yasiin bey (Mos Def), and The Black Keys. His powerful playing, infectious energy, humor, and generosity made him a beloved figure in the New Orleans music community. Ronell was deeply committed to preserving and sharing the musical traditions of his hometown. His legacy lives on through the countless musicians and audiences he inspired---and through his many years as a featured musician at Nickel-A-Dance. This performance features the Ronell Johnson Tribute band is led by trombonist Craig Klein and features: Brandon Lewis - trumpet Ben Jaffe - sousaphone Clint Maedgen - saxophone Jafet Perez - drums Kyle Roussel - piano Russel Welch - guitar This is a free progam with no ticketing. Just come ready to dance. For more info on Nickel-A-Dance, visit: https://www.nojc.org/nickel-a-dance Shows from 3-6pm Doors at 2:30pm

events.name: Schooled with Soul Sister: Deep Dive into Parliament-Funkadelic and the Mothership
events.info: This show will be inside at Gasa Gasa Class is in session, and this time, you're getting schooled in the funk. Join DJ Soul Sister for a special deep dive into Parliament-Funkadelic, the wildly inventive musical universe of George Clinton, and the story of the Mothership, celebrating 50 years since its first-ever landing, which happened in New Orleans. In this conversation-style lecture, Soul Sister steps away from the turntables to dig into the history, ideas, and innovations that made P-Funk one of the most influential forces in modern music. Whether you already know your Funkentelechy from your Maggot Brain or you're just ready to find out what all this Mothership business is about, come get schooled. Presented in conjunction with Soul Sister's Mothership Month, a series of P-Funk-related events taking place throughout October and funded by NOLAxNOLA.

events.name: Davell Crawford & Co. featuring James Jordan
events.info: Davell Crawford & Co. featuring James JordanDavell Crawford, New Orleans' celebrated , "rdquo" -> Piano Prince," is a renowned pianist, vocalist, composer, and arranger whose music blends gospel, jazz, blues, funk, and soul. A musical prodigy who began playing piano at two, Crawford carries on a rich family legacy as the grandson of R&B legend James , "rdquo" -> Sugar Boy" Crawford. He has performed worldwide and collaborated with artists including Roberta Flack, Dr. John, Allen Toussaint, Ellis Marsalis, and Lionel Hampton. Through his performances, recordings, and music education work, Crawford continues to champion the rich tradition of New Orleans piano and American roots music. For this performance, Davell is joined by James Jordan. James Jordan is a New Orleans-based vocalist whose rich baritone blends R&B, funk, jazz, and swing with timeless style. Born in Washington, D.C., he has earned a reputation as a dynamic and versatile performer whose soulful interpretations captivate audiences in settings ranging from intimate duos to big bands. His 2026 debut album, Reflections, explores finding freedom, joy, and growth through life's challenges. Experience an unforgettable evening of New Orleans music with two dynamic performers joining forces on the Snug Harbor stage. Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Restaurant is Open 5pm - 11pm for dinner before or after your showtime: Advance Ticket Holders can now automatically make dinner table reservations for the Dining Room online via OpenTable.com ! Dinner Service without Advance Concert Tickets is first-come, first-served based on availability upon arrival. Bar Room is Open 5pm - Midnight for all, with or without tickets. events.name: Matt Chamberlain & Brian Haas
events.info: Grammy Award-winning drummer Matt Chamberlain and pianist and musical iconoclast Brian Haas come together for a rare night of musical collaboration on Sunday, October 4th at Gasa Gasa. Haas, whose wide-ranging work includes Nolatet, Jacob Fred Jazz Odyssey, Compersion Quartet, Compulsion Trio, Mike Dillon Band, Punkadelick and Tephra Sound, joins Chamberlain, whose extensive recording and touring career includes work with David Bowie, Fiona Apple, Joni Mitchell, Bob Dylan, Bill Frisell, Brad Mehldau, Tori Amos and Frank Ocean. The two first recorded together on Frames, an 11-part instrumental suite composed by Haas that draws from stride piano, early minimalism and modern electronic music. Their second collaboration, Prometheus Risen, turned that process inside out, born from three days of live improvisation combining keyboards, Moog bass, ambient textures, loops and Chamberlain's expansive approach to groove and percussion. The collaboration continues at Gasa Gasa. Don't miss this rare chance to catch two masters of their craft drawing on decades of experience, deep creative trust and the possibilities of complete spontaneity.

events.info: Charmaine Neville BandCharmaine Neville, daughter of legendary saxophonist Charles Neville of the Neville Brothers, carries the torch of a rich New Orleans musical legacy. While she is rooted in the city's vibrant traditions, Charmaine brings her own unique voice to the stage, blending R&B, Jazz, and world rhythms into a sound that's all her own.
